parameters.help_en: The instance ID of the primary/standby instance. You can set the default value to the instance ID of the instance to be switched to the primary instance

parameters.help_en: The instance ID of the instance to be switched to the primary instance
parameters.help_zh: 需要切换为主实例的实例 ID
parameters.name: target_instance_id

parameters.help_en:
Whether to force the switchover.
- true: Force the switchover.
- false: Do not force the switchover

是否强制切换主备实例。取值范围：

- **true**：表示强制切换主备实例。

- **false**：表示不强制切换主备实例
parameters.name: forced
